description: CIACUA, the water supply and sewer research centre of the Universidad de los Andes, produced a family of programs: REDES for hydraulic and water quality modelling of water supply networks, REDCAD and REDGIS for exchange with CAD and GIS, CALIBRA and GENÉTICA for manual and genetic-algorithm calibration, ASIGNA for assigning users to nodes, SERIES and MICROMEDIDORES for logger and meter data, RIEGOS for high-frequency irrigation systems, and UTOPÍA and ALCANTARILLADOS for optimised least-cost urban drainage design. Coverage is any network, from a Colombian developer. Access is on request: the page lists the programs without a download or licence terms. Caveats: no versions or documentation are shown. Simulation uses: network flow, calibration and drainage design optimisation. Related records: EPANET (model-epanet).
